svg.aria-label: STAR breakdown of the Data Center to Cloud migration story
svg.text: Story 03 · Data Center → Cloud migration (Atlassian) — STAR
Global migration of enterprise customers from Data Center to Cloud. TEAM
owned commerce; the licensing transition was complex and ambiguous.
Engineer the checkout + provisioning workflows that make the migration work.
Mapped Data Center → Cloud licensing transitions; nailed the edge cases first.
Engineered CHECKOUT (correct price + credit for what they already owned)
and PROVISIONING (customer actually entitled on Cloud to what they paid for).
Handled it carefully — live enterprise revenue [FILL IN — de-risking].
Enterprise customers migrated with licensing transitioned correctly [FILL IN — metric].
Lesson: with ambiguous mappings, resolve the edge cases before you build the flow.
Signals: navigating ambiguity · technical complexity · enterprise stakes · customer-centric
[FILL IN] items are placeholders — add the real edge case, de-risking, and metric before using this story.
